verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a registrar that ships SDKs, an MCP server and a web account, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics or tracking controls. WHOIS privacy protection is a different capability (hiding registrant contact data) and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
